analyze.description: Cerebrate performs read-only analysis, review, interrogation, or recommendation. No branch, no commit, no PR, no implementation agents.

report.description: Overlord delivers the analysis to the user. Terminal — never escalates into implementation unless a new workflow is explicitly selected.

question.description: Question gate: the analysis returned open_questions. The overlord asks the user, and the answer goes back to the state that asked, in the same run: the outcome is the name of that state, which runs again with the answer. cancelled ends the run.
